title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH pitch from Dodgers' Will Klein in the third inning.
Contreras initially stayed in the game but was replaced defensively the following half-inning by Nick Sogard.
Contreras leads the Red Sox in batting average, home runs, and RBIs, highlighting his crucial role for the team.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joined Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach after a stint with the New England Patriots.
Hopkins gained coaching experience at Patriots training camp while considering his future in football beyond playing.
Hopkins joins former Patriots staff member Vinnie Sunseri at Georgia Tech but hasn't retired from the NFL.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for spots on the Patriots' 53-man roster amid a crowded receiver group.
The Patriots typically carry six receivers but currently have seven vying for positions, including recent acquisition Romeo Doubs.
Kayshon Boutte remains uncertain, affecting decisions for younger receivers like Chism and Williams before the season starts.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer is reportedly open to a trade from the Blue Jays to the Boston Red Sox, enhancing outfield options.
Xavier Edwards, a Marlins infielder, interests the Red Sox for added infield depth amid injuries to key players.
Springer has played well historically at Fenway, while Edwards is versatile and offers strong contact hitting and base-stealing.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' features Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep and is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama', directed by Kristoffer Borgli, stars Zendaya and Robert Pattinson and is streaming on HBO Max.
New TV series 'President Curtis', a 'Rick & Morty' spinoff, is available on HBO Max.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran criticized Red Sox teammate Willson Contreras and/or coach Chad Epperson mid-game, stirring reactions from broadcasters and fans.
NESN and WEEI broadcasts condemned Duran's outburst, with commentators noting Contreras had little chance to score on the play.
Athletics' broadcasters and CBS Sports confirmed Duran's frustration was mainly directed at coach Chad Epperson, not Contreras.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown are strengthening their chemistry during New England Patriots training camp.
Maye successfully connected with Brown on four out of five targets during the fifth practice session.
Frequent practice plays and constant communication are helping Maye and Brown prepare for tight coverages this season.

title: Drake Maye, A.J. Brown heat up and other takeaways from Day 6 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye completed 18-of-19 throws during team drills since padded practices began, showing strong performance in camp.
A.J. Brown built his connection with Maye in Friday's practice, successfully executing several plays, including against top cornerbacks.
Romeo Doubs and Eli Raridon made notable plays, with Doubs executing a standout red zone catch and Raridon securing a touchdown.

title: Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report
author: Annie Jonas
bullets: Massachusetts fell to 11th in the U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings, previously ranking 9th.
Massachusetts maintained a strong performance in healthcare, retaining its No. 2 ranking despite overall ranking drop.
The state's fiscal stability (39th) and infrastructure (38th) negatively impacted Massachusetts' overall ranking.

title: Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: IHOP closed its Cambridge and Hyannis locations, leaving 19 other locations open in Massachusetts.
The Hyannis IHOP served customers for over 50 years and was a known late-night spot.
Closures are attributed to declining foot traffic or potential lease issues, per IHOP franchisee statement.
